segments.ja501:1.1: Ete yūthā patiyanti, bhītā maraṇassa [maraṇā (syā. pī.), maraṇa (ka.)] cittaka;
segments.ja501:1.3: Gaccha tuvampi mākaṅkhi, jīvissanti tayā saha.
segments.ja501:2.1: Nāhaṃ rohaṇa [rohanta (sī. pī.), rohana (syā.)] gacchāmi, hadayaṃ me avakassati;
segments.ja501:2.3: Na taṃ ahaṃ jahissāmi, idha hissāmi jīvitaṃ.
segments.ja501:3.1: Te hi nūna marissanti, andhā apariṇāyakā;
segments.ja501:3.3: Gaccha tuvampi mākaṅkhi, jīvissanti tayā saha.
segments.ja501:4.1: Nāhaṃ rohaṇa gacchāmi, hadayaṃ me avakassati;
segments.ja501:4.3: Na taṃ baddhaṃ [bandhaṃ (ka.)] jahissāmi, idha hissāmi jīvitaṃ.
segments.ja501:5.1: Gaccha bhīru palāyassu, kūṭe baddhosmi āyase;
segments.ja501:5.3: Gaccha tuvampi mākaṅkhi, jīvissanti tayā saha.
segments.ja501:6.1: Nāhaṃ rohaṇa gacchāmi, hadayaṃ me avakassati;
segments.ja501:6.3: Na taṃ ahaṃ jahissāmi, idha hissāmi jīvitaṃ.
segments.ja501:7.1: Te hi nūna marissanti, andhā apariṇāyakā;
segments.ja501:7.3: Gaccha tuvampi mākaṅkhi, jīvissanti tayā saha.
segments.ja501:8.1: Nāhaṃ rohaṇa gacchāmi, hadayaṃ me avakassati;
segments.ja501:8.3: Na taṃ baddhaṃ jahissāmi, idha hissāmi jīvitaṃ.
segments.ja501:9.1: Ayaṃ so luddako eti, luddarūpo [ruddarūpo (sī. pī.)] sahāvudho;
segments.ja501:9.3: Yo no vadhissati ajja, usunā sattiyā api [mapi (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja501:11.1: Kinnu teme migā honti, muttā baddhaṃ upāsare;
segments.ja501:12.1: Bhātaro honti me ludda, sodariyā ekamātukā;
segments.ja501:13.1: Te hi nūna marissanti, andhā apariṇāyakā;
segments.ja501:13.3: Pañcannaṃ jīvitaṃ dehi, bhātaraṃ muñca luddaka.
segments.ja501:14.1: So vo ahaṃ pamokkhāmi, mātāpettibharaṃ migaṃ;
segments.ja501:15.1: Evaṃ luddaka nandassu, saha sabbehi ñātibhi;
segments.ja501:16.1: Kathaṃ tvaṃ pamokkho [kathaṃ pamokkho (sī. pī.), kathaṃ te parokkho (?)] āsi, upanītasmi jīvite;
segments.ja501:20.1: Evaṃ ānandito hotu, saha dārehi luddako;
segments.ja501:21.1: Nanu tvaṃ avaca [avacā (sī. pī.)] ludda,“migacammāni āhariṃ”;
segments.ja501:21.3: Atha kena nu vaṇṇena, migacammāni nāhari.
segments.ja501:22.1: Āgamā ceva hatthatthaṃ, kūṭapāsañca so migo;
segments.ja501:22.3: Abajjhi taṃ [abajjhi tañca (pī.)] migarājaṃ, tañca muttā upāsare.
segments.ja501:23.1: Tassa me ahu saṃvego, abbhuto lomahaṃsano;
segments.ja501:23.3: Imañcāhaṃ migaṃ haññe, ajja hissāmi jīvitaṃ.
segments.ja501:24.1: Kīdisā te migā ludda, kīdisā dhammikā migā;
segments.ja501:24.3: Kathaṃvaṇṇā kathaṃsīlā, bāḷhaṃ kho ne pasaṃsasi.
segments.ja501:26.1: Edisā te migā deva, edisā dhammikā migā;
segments.ja501:26.3: Mātāpettibharā deva, na te so abhihārituṃ [abhihārayuṃ (ka. sī.), abhihārayiṃ (syā.), abhihārayaṃ (pī.)].
segments.ja501:27.3: Catussadañca [caturassañca (syā. ka.)] pallaṅkaṃ, umāpupphasarinnibhaṃ [ummāpupphasirinnibhaṃ (sī. syā. pī. ka.)].
segments.ja501:28.1: Dve ca sādisiyo bhariyā, usabhañca gavaṃ sataṃ;
segments.ja501:28.3: Dhammena rajjaṃ kāressaṃ, bahukāro mesi luddaka.
segments.ja501:29.1: Kasivāṇijjā [kasī vaṇijjā (sī. syā. pī.)] iṇadānaṃ, uñchācariyā ca luddaka;
segments.ja501:29.3: Etena dāraṃ posehi, mā pāpaṃ akarī punāti [akarā punanti (ka. sī. pī.)].
